long-term survival of intra- arterial infusion chemotherapy for patients with P0H (+), synchronous liver metastases is possible.

intra-arterial chemotherapy with Lentinan or LAK cells in combination with conventional chemotherapy is useful for the control of liver metastases in patients with advanced gastric cancer.

intra-arterial chemotherapy via the common hepatic arterial catheter is an effective treatment for gastric cancers with liver metastases, and that long-term survival is possible in some patients with liver metastasis.
